title: Antigravity adapter: guard the CLI file tools, bind the dispatch model, admit the design-phase scripts
goal: On the Antigravity runner (1) every native file tool of the Antigravity CLI reaches the same write/read guards as the IDE tools: `write_file` (arguments `Path`, `Content`) is handled like `write_to_file`, `edit_file` (arguments `Path`, `Target`, `Replacement`) like `replace_file_content`, `read_file` (argument `Path`) like `view_file`, in the hook matcher (`plugins/pipeline-core/hooks.json`), in `plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/antigravity-pretool-guard.mjs` and in every other place that lists the IDE names (find them with `rg -l write_to_file plugins/pipeline-core`: `lib/tool-write-target.mjs`, the installer that writes the user-level Antigravity hooks file if it carries its own matcher, and the references/tests that pin the names); (2) `invoke_subagent` is bound to a model by the guard: the tool's `Model` enum is `inherit | flash_lite | flash | pro`; K144 (commit `439f4c60d`) already gives the Antigravity runner no opinion on the Claude selectors; add the Antigravity rule so that a dispatch whose `Model` is absent or `inherit` is refused with a message that names the admitted values and the repair (silent inheritance of the session model is the failure MP-29 closes), and a `Model` outside the enum is refused; if the V3 runner-profile registry names the expected selector for the dispatched role on the Antigravity runner, require equality, otherwise accept any non-inherit enum value; (3) the three scripts that the Antigravity references demand in the design phase, `scripts/model-role-bootstrap.mjs`, `scripts/antigravity-native-dispatch-prepare.mjs` and `scripts/design-review-receipt.mjs`, are admitted by the shell guard in lifecycle `draft` (and `implementing` where the references use them) with exactly their sanctioned subcommands and argument shapes, not by widening any generic rule (today they are refused as `GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL: lifecycle is draft`; find the command catalogue under `plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard/` and `lib/guard-devplan-policy.mjs`). Each of the three changes has a regression pin that is RED on the unchanged code. Work in your own clone `scratch/clones/k152` (`git clone --quiet . scratch/clones/k152` from the repository root). Deliver committed work in that clone plus `K152-protected.diff` / `K152-unprotected.diff` / `K152-msg-protected.txt` / `K152-msg-unprotected.txt` / `K152-notes.md` in the main checkout's `scratch/agent-out/` (message files end with the two trailer lines `AI-Assisted: true` and `Dispatch: stage-0 (elephant)` as their last paragraph; an empty diff may be omitted). The diffs must pass `git apply --check` in a second fresh clone `scratch/clones/k152-check`. Order of work: (1), then (3), then (2); deliver whatever is complete when the budget ends.
